CreateQuotaApplicationsForTemplate.title: CreateQuotaApplicationsForTemplate
CreateQuotaApplicationsForTemplate.summary: When you add a quota to a quota template, quota increase requests are automatically submitted only for new members in the resource directory. Existing members are not affected. To increase the quotas for existing members, you can use a quota template to submit batch requests. Only the administrator account of a resource directory can create batch quota requests.

CreateTemplateQuotaItem.title: CreateTemplateQuotaItem
CreateTemplateQuotaItem.summary: After a management account creates a quota template, the template automatically submits a quota increase request for any new member added to the resource directory. Existing members are not affected. Quota templates allow you to request increases for multiple quota items at once, which improves the efficiency and automation of quota management for your entire organization. Only the management account of a resource directory can create quota templates.

DeleteTemplateQuotaItem.title: DeleteTemplateQuotaItem
DeleteTemplateQuotaItem.summary: Deletes a quota template by using the management account of a resource directory. After you delete a quota template, if a member is added to the resource directory, the quota template no longer automatically submits a quota increase request for the member. Only the management account of a resource directory can delete quota templates.

GetProductQuota.title: GetProductQuota
GetProductQuota.summary: Queries the details of a quota for a specified Alibaba Cloud product.

GetProductQuotaDimension.title: GetProductQuotaDimension
GetProductQuotaDimension.summary: Queries the details of quota dimensions for a specific Alibaba Cloud service.

GetQuotaAlarm.title: GetQuotaAlarm
GetQuotaAlarm.summary: Queries the details of a specific quota alert.

GetQuotaApplication.title: GetQuotaApplication
GetQuotaApplication.summary: Queries the details of a quota increase application.

GetQuotaApplicationApproval.title: GetQuotaApplicationApproval
GetQuotaApplicationApproval.summary: Queries the approval details for a quota increase application, including the average approval time, whether approval reminders are supported, and the reminder interval.

GetQuotaTemplateServiceStatus.title: GetQuotaTemplateServiceStatus
GetQuotaTemplateServiceStatus.summary: Queries the status of a quota template.

ListAlarmHistories.title: ListAlarmHistories
ListAlarmHistories.summary: Queries the history of quota alerts.

ListDependentQuotas.title: ListDependentQuotas
ListDependentQuotas.summary: Some quotas are dependent on others and must be increased together. This operation lists the quotas that a specified quota depends on.

ListProductDimensionGroups.title: ListProductDimensionGroups
ListProductDimensionGroups.summary: This operation queries the dimension groups of a specified Alibaba Cloud service.

ListProductQuotaDimensions.title: ListProductQuotaDimensions
ListProductQuotaDimensions.summary: Queries the quota dimensions supported by a specified Alibaba Cloud service.

ListProductQuotas.title: ListProductQuotas
ListProductQuotas.summary: Queries a list of quotas for a specified cloud product.

ListProducts.title: ListProducts
ListProducts.summary: Queries the cloud products supported by Quota Center.

ListQuotaApplicationTemplates.title: ListQuotaApplicationTemplates
ListQuotaApplicationTemplates.summary: Queries quota templates by using the management account of a resource directory.

ListQuotaApplications.title: Query quota increase applications
ListQuotaApplications.summary: Queries the list of quota increase applications.

ListQuotaApplicationsDetailForTemplate.title: ListQuotaApplicationsDetailForTemplate
ListQuotaApplicationsDetailForTemplate.summary: Queries the details of quota increase applications for a member in a resource directory.

ListQuotaApplicationsForTemplate.title: ListQuotaApplicationsForTemplate
ListQuotaApplicationsForTemplate.summary: Queries the history of batch requests for member quotas submitted using a quota template.

ModifyQuotaTemplateServiceStatus.title: ModifyQuotaTemplateServiceStatus
ModifyQuotaTemplateServiceStatus.summary: Changes the status of a quota template. By default, the quota template is not configured. If the management account of a resource directory uses a quota template for the first time, you must enable the quota template. Only the management account of a resource directory can change the status of quota templates.

ModifyTemplateQuotaItem.title: ModifyTemplateQuotaItem
ModifyTemplateQuotaItem.summary: Only the administrator account of a resource directory can modify a quota template. Modifications to a quota template apply only to new members that are added to the resource directory and do not affect existing members.

RemindQuotaApplicationApproval.title: RemindQuotaApplicationApproval
RemindQuotaApplicationApproval.summary: Sends a reminder for a quota application that is pending approval.
